description: List every share link this user has minted — kind, what it points at (deck or location name), public URL, whether it is revoked, and for deck links what they show (show_printings, show_proxies: 1 or 0).
name: list_share_links

links.description: Every link the user minted, newest first, revoked ones included

revoked.description: 1: the link is offline for good

rule.description: A tradelist by rule (no place): what it offers. unclaimed every copy no deck claims; spares_card / spares_printing all but one copy of each card / printing. null: not a tradelist by rule

show_printings.description: A deck link: 1 shows the exact printings the owner plays, 0 the list alone

show_proxies.description: A deck link: 1 shows which copies are proxies, 0 withholds it

url.description: The public URL: anyone holding it can view the list until it is revoked

title: List share links
